gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patient has consented to craniotomy for suspected glioma of any type with 5-ALA infusion.

candidate_evidence.quote: The purpose of this study is to determine whether use of an ultra-high sensitivity camera with enhanced imaging technology can be used during surgery to detect areas of brain tissue affected by diffuse glioma, a type of brain cancer.

role_evidence.quote: Participants will undergo 5-ALA guided tumour resection via craniotomy with the aim of achieving maximal safe tumour resection without significant neurological deficit.

arms: Intraoperative imaging of 5-ALA during tumour resection

coder_notes: Imaging/camera study of 5-ALA fluorescence-guided resection in suspected glioma of any type; glioblastoma never named (conditions 'Glioma', keyword 'Malignant glioma'). Coded not_glioblastoma (glioma of any grade, not specifically high-grade); high_grade_glioma_unspecified would give the same exclusion. 5-ALA is not a registered intervention but every patient receives it for fluorescence-guided surgery -> diagnostic_agent. Registry phase NA.
